visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Medium Check: Graphic-based intro. The screen is entirely black with Traditional Chinese text in the center. White characters read '女生獨旅 第一次遇到' and yellow characters below read '攻擊性的歧視'. (2) Characters & Micro-Actions: A young Asian woman is in the foreground, filmed in a selfie-style close-up. She has dark hair and visible emotional distress, with slightly puffy eyes. She wears a black and white patterned turban and large colorful dangling earrings. Her mouth moves as she speaks directly into the camera. Objects: A small black lavalier microphone is clipped to her white shirt. Setting: The background is a vast desert with golden sand and clear blue sky. Distant figures of people are visible near a large sandstone rock formation. (3) Characters & Micro-Actions: Handheld walking shot. The woman continues to speak, her head moving slightly as she walks, looking down occasionally. Lighting: Natural, bright sunlight casts soft shadows on her face. Setting: The background changes slightly to show more of the desert expanse and another large, ancient-looking rocky structure. A white golf-cart buggy is stationary in the mid-ground. (4) Medium Check: Graphic-based outro. The screen transitions back to black with white text asking the audience: '大家有親身經歷 讓你難忘一輩子的事件嗎?'.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 女生獨旅 第一次遇到 攻擊性的歧視. (2) [Subtitle]: 剛其實發生一些事情 讓我有點想哭... (3) [Subtitle]: 這裡有個工作人員 說她是當地原住民 (正在 沙烏地 參加旅遊團). (4) [Subtitle]: 所以她就回來這裡當導遊. (5) [Subtitle]: 我前面就是在拍攝的時候 有一些西方女生就是. (6) [Subtitle]: 對我很沒禮貌 就是她們有那種歧視的感覺. (7) [Subtitle]: 就是我在拍 我先到的. (8) [Subtitle]: 而且我才到大概 30秒不到喔. (9) [Subtitle]: 然後她們就用那種叫小狗的方式 (還發出大聲的訕笑...). (10) [Subtitle]: 就是吹口哨. (11) [Subtitle]: Hey lady 什麼什麼的.. move 什麼什麼的.. (還發出大聲的訕笑...). (12) [Subtitle]: 她們其實可以說 excuse me 或之類的. (13) [Subtitle]: 就是很歧視... (14) [Subtitle]: 結果後來那個工作人員 就走到我旁邊. (15) [Subtitle]: 然後她就跟我說對不起. (16) [Subtitle]: 她一直跟我說對不起誒! (17) [Subtitle]: 又不是她的問題! (18) [Subtitle]: 她在後面要引導其他人往前走 所以她沒有注意到我. (19) [Subtitle]: 她知道我其實 剛到只是要拍照. (20) [Subtitle]: 然後那些女生就是 在大家面前對我很沒禮貌. (21) [Subtitle]: 她說她覺得很對不起. (22) [Subtitle]: 她希望我在這邊的回憶是很快樂的. (23) [Subtitle]: 等一下她會請其他人特別照顧我. (24) [Subtitle]: 我現在講一講我都要哭了 (還在慌...). (25) [Subtitle]: 在外面面對這種歧視... (26) [Subtitle]: 然後當地人就是馬上給你溫暖. (27) [Subtitle]: 她還跑過來 特別幫我拍照 qq. (28) [Subtitle]: 第一次在這麼多人面前被歧視. (29) [Slogan]: 大家有親身經歷 讓你難忘一輩子的事件嗎?

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To share a personal emotional experience of facing discrimination during a solo trip to Saudi Arabia and highlighting the contrasting kindness received from a local staff member. It aims to connect with the audience through vulnerability and ask for shared experiences.
